limitations_and_integrity: Proves only direction-uniform chords through a fixed point in nondegenerate Euclidean parallelograms, including boundary base points. No all-convex-body claim or invariant-random-line claim. Full public primary 2026 triangle exposition and indexed comparisons support bounded novelty, with explicitly documented residual priority risk. Proof is self-contained; illustrative quadrature is not a certificate.
title: A sharp mean-chord inequality for all parallelograms
